content:
Lina: Quick heads-up — want to recruit ~6 design partners focused on regulated fintech to validate our Private onboarding + KMS/SSO flows. Target window: May-June. Thoughts?
Marcus: +1. We should be explicit about data residency and audit logs requirements. Those are blockers for banks.
Elena: Agreed. Also we need to surface the onboarding time expectation in the outreach (so we don't get ghost signups). 2 week onboarding target?
Sam: 2 weeks seems optimistic for on-prem, but for VPC it could work. Maybe split by deployment: VPC target 2w, on-prem target 6w.
Lina: Good call. Proposed recruitment constraints: must have a compliance owner, existing CI/CD for infra, and a pilot workload that touches PII or payments. Incentive: 3 months free Dedicated / 2 weeks on-prem integration support.
Marcus: Can we offer a limited audit package (SOC-like checklist) as part of the incentive? That could move enterprise teams.
Elena: Yes — throw in a one-page security review and an onboarding checklist. Also require an NDA before sharing infra details.
Sam: I'll draft an intake form. Basic fields:
```
company_name
primary_contact
role (eng/sec/product)
use_case summary
deployment preference (Hosted / VPC / On-prem)
data classification
expected qps
compliance contacts
onboarding window availability
```
Lina: perfect. Let's also add "success criteria" from partner side: readiness to run a 2-week pilot with our sample prompts, a committed integration owner, and willingness to attend weekly check-ins.
Marcus: On our side, success criteria should be: onboarding < target window, end-to-end telemetry enabled, basic eval set shows no regression vs. hosted baseline, and at least one actionable product ask we can prioritize.
Elena: For metrics, propose: time-to-first-inference, 95th-p50 latency delta vs hosted, token cost per 1k tokens, and number of blocking issues per week.
Lina: + timeline: outreach week 1, intake signups week 2, NDA + prioritization week 3, onboarding starts week 4. Pilot runs weeks 5-8, wrap + decisions week 9.
Sam: How do we structure feedback? Weekly 30m sync + asynchronous Notion survey after each sprint. Also require partners to assign a primary contact for bug triage.
Marcus: Add a lightweight evaluation rubric we can share with partners so they know what we'll measure. Draft below:
- Onboarding completeness: docs + infra + secrets configured (Y/N)
- Stability: < 5% error rate for pilot workload
- Performance: 95th percentile latency within X% of baseline
- Security gating: KMS/HSM + SSO configured or plan documented
- Product signal: partner provides 5 concrete feature asks or prioritized issues
Elena: That rubric looks good. We should categorize asks into "Must fix for pilot", "Worth prioritizing", and "Future".
Lina: Outreach copy draft: "We're running a short design partner program to validate Private inference for regulated fintech teams. We provide integration support, audit docs, and credits. Looking for teams that can commit an integration owner and run a 2–4 week pilot."
Sam: I'll put together an outreach list. Targets: 1) mid-size payments providers, 2) embedded finance platforms, 3) regtech vendors who might embed LLMs.
Marcus: Sequence for outreach: email -> quick 15m intro -> intake form -> NDA -> scoping call. Keep the email short and link to intake form + one-pager.
Elena: Could we offer a recorded tech walkthrough (10m) they can watch before intro? Saves time.
Lina: Yes — dp-bot: create video + one-pager asset.
dp-bot: Created asset: https://drive.redwood/inference/dp-finreg-onepager.mp4 and intake form: https://forms.redwood/dp-finreg-intake
Sam: For participant selection, we should score by: alignment with product goals (30%), deployment feasibility (30%), size of impact (20%), and speed to onboard (20%).
Marcus: Also add a redline for legal: no data-sharing beyond telemetry unless explicitly allowed. We'll need a short addendum for on-prem that outlines responsibilities.
Elena: OK to pilot without full SOC if they commit to the checklist? Some partners won't have SOC right away.
Lina: Yes — allow "security plan" as alternative to full SOC for pilot eligibility. We should document required checkpoints.
Sam: I'll draft the intake form + scoring sheet today and post in this thread.
Lina: Great. Final ask: capture evaluation outputs as a Notion table so PM/Eng can prioritize follow-ups.
Marcus: Also capture economic metrics — estimated per-token cost at their QPS and projected savings per 100k tokens.
Elena: One more: add a dropout threshold. If a partner hasn't completed onboarding activities in 3 weeks beyond target, move to standby.
Lina: Love it. Thanks everyone — Sam, post the draft intake and the outreach email and we'll review.
Sam: Will do. Posting now: https://forms.redwood/dp-finreg-intake (draft) and outreach copy in thread.
Sam: Outreach copy: "Hi — Redwood Inference is selecting a small group of regulated fintech teams to validate Private inference deployments. We'd love to explore a short pilot (2–6 weeks depending on deployment) and offer integration support + credits. Interested? Fill this two-minute intake: https://forms.redwood/dp-finreg-intake"
Marcus: :thumbsup:
Elena: :raised_hands:
Lina: Adding this to the roadmap tracker and will loop in legal for the NDA template.
Sam: last: timeline updated in tracker -> https://notion.redwood/roadmaps/dp-finreg (ETA for decisions 3 weeks).
